source_context.creator: Marek Dabrowski
source_context.caption_hook: Most plants don’t have a Lean problem.
caption_argument_segments: Most plants don’t have a Lean problem. They have a layer problem.
They try to improve culture before standard work exists.
They ask for accountability before the work is visible.
They install dashboards before people agree what “normal” looks like.
They run Kaizen events before daily management is stable. And then everyone wonders why the improvement doesn’t hold.
A Lean operation is built in layers:
